descriptions.d15b_flush_pending_messages_800a7fdc: When the pending flag is set, send the stored low/high range under one of two cached message names (chosen by a mode bit); then for each entry in the unsigned active window, including inactive entries only when the all-entries bit is set, send every type-3 item's cached message with the two stored values followed by the entry name text (from its second character); finally clear both stored values and the pending flag. Partial observed layouts; cached message keys referenced by address; no owned initialized data.
